title: pages.page_changed v1 (event payload)
description: Published by the pages module when a page is made or changed, put in the trash or brought back, moved, shared or deleted for good; the search module re-reads the page from it, and the change feed announces it to the members who may open the page. Ids and enums only, never a title or any text. `revision` grows with every change of one page: apply only newer ones. Body changes are published at most once every 5 seconds per page. Workspace-scoped; also listed in openapi/events.json.

parent.description: The page it is under, or null at the top level.

kinds.description: What changed: the title or icon (`meta`), the body, who it is shared with, its parent, place or position, the trash, or its deletion for good; for a table, its properties (`schema`) or views (`views`); for a row, its values (`values`).

row.description: Whether the page is a row of a table (its `parent`): a row is followed through its table's container. Absent means false.
